summary: Dow and S&P are climbing while the Nasdaq slips, as investors rotate out of AI-exposed tech names and into safer corners. Falling Treasury yields are cushioning the sell-off and giving the Dow a lift.
market_note: Divergence day: Dow futures up while Nasdaq futures sag, as the tech rotation continues into the afternoon.

items.why: Chip stocks are selling off as investors question AI spending; CNN reports the global chipmaker sell-off is deepening as enthusiasm for AI stocks wobbles.
WTI is climbing after the EIA reported an unexpected 8.6 million barrel crude draw, with Hurricane Isaias shutting in Gulf output and Hormuz shipping risks supporting prices, per the WSJ.
The NYT reports tech stocks are dropping further amid doubts over AI spending, and the chipmaker sell-off is hitting AI-exposed names like Nvidia hardest.
The 10-year yield is falling as Treasuries rally, with investors seeking shelter from the AI-stock turbulence, per the FT; Yahoo notes yields are sinking while the Dow advances.
